justification: Joint probability draw: 1,459 high-SNR geometry references, 12.16% NMAD, +0.0684 nat signed Gaia gain, and 370 dwarf associations among 379 archived class matches. Signed interval near support is 93.46% of design weight. Strict membership is retained alongside the primary cut.
limitations: Class match fraction is reference-conditional. A confirmed far giant remains at both cuts. Gaia point calibration is not transferred to weak-parallax objects, where the nominal SED scores better. Applies to the registered DECam fields and is magnitude-limited. Distances beyond 10 kpc and the full QRF tail remain in each posterior.
